verdict.rationale: Smooth's own docs show a natural-language goal passed to `smooth_client.run(...)` and executed by its browser agent. They also document multi-step form navigation with dropdowns, checkboxes and submission, plus sequential session workflows covering logging in, navigating and extracting. A community member reports writing a complex prompt and getting a good result. Missing for 10: independent, reproducible hands-on corroboration of end-to-end reliability on complex flows (the one community report is anecdotal, and no third-party evals are cited).

support.subject: As a developer, I can hand the product a natural-language goal and it completes a multi-step web task end to end — navigating, filling forms, and clicking through flows

citations.quote: task = smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight from London to Paris today")
Your agent can navigate complex multi-step forms, handle dropdowns and checkboxes, and submit data
This is useful for complex workflows like logging in, navigating, and extracting data across multiple pages.
I just wrote a complex prompt and it did a good job.
